Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Lumen Stent is MR Conditional. A person with the Lumen Stent may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Lumen Stent
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 and 3.0 Tesla
Type of Nuclei 31P (phosphorus)
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 100 T/m/s per axis
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: Maximum Whole-Body SAR 2 W/kg
For 3T MR Scanner: B1+rms <= 1.5 microtesla; Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1 W/kg
Scan Duration at 1.5T: Maximum active scan time of 30 minutes.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
